_comment: Themis exam AP policy for the Kali/Linux host. See docs/LINUX_AP.md. 'airgap' is the only profile that can prove no online lookup, no cloud AI, and no VPN or Tor -- because with no uplink there is nothing for any of them to reach.
_channel_comment: mt7921u does NOT support DFS channels in AP mode. Stay on 36-48 or 149-165 (US). 36 with 80MHz width covers 36-48.
